case.summary: The evidence is not sufficient to decide on this customer report alert for card C09988-K1, at a fraud probability of 0.53 resting on 1 independent signal(s): the cardholder does not recognise the transaction (arrived as the trigger). The activity fits card not present new device: a card-not-present transaction on a device new to the account. The closest alternative was card_not_present_fraud (0.40 against 0.65): a card-not-present transaction; the new device makes the new-device variant the better fit. Recommended actions: STEP_UP_AUTH, VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER, BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, with exposure of $59.67.
